about: Thirty of Jordan's past decisions, the material Bug Me's onboarding reads (docs/STAGE-10.md). Hand-written and synthetic like everything here, consistent with Jordan's projects, rules and facts. seconds = how long the question waited on screen before Jordan answered.

decisions.question: Run prettier across the SDK repo? 212 files change, formatting only.
Bump eslint from 9.4.0 to 9.4.2 (patch)?
Delete 14 merged branches older than 30 days?
decisions.reason: Why are you asking me this? Just do it.

decisions.question: Add the date-fns library to the TypeScript SDK to format retry-after headers?
The new provider rounds tax per line, the old one per invoice. Switch rounding mode now (fast) or match the old behaviour first (two more days)?
decisions.reason: A one-cent difference on an invoice is a support ticket and a lost customer. Slip it, get it right.

decisions.question: Reconcile the v2 pagination path with the T-12 cursor shim, or drop the shim?
decisions.typed: I don't know what the T-12 shim is. What happens to people paging through results today if you drop it?

decisions.question: checkout.spec.ts failed 3 of the last 20 runs. Quarantine it with a ticket, or delete it?
Ship the new error format for /v2/notes? Diff attached below.
decisions.reason: Don't paste me a diff. Put it on a preview and send me the link; I'll click through it.

decisions.question: Move the invoice job to the new provider this Friday, or after month-end close?
decisions.reason: Correctness over speed in billing. After month-end.

decisions.question: Accept the weekly platform sync invite (Tuesdays 10am)?
Rename user_id to account_id in the v2 responses? Recommended for consistency with the internal schema.
decisions.reason: Integrators parse that field today. Tidiness isn't worth breaking customers. What's the strongest case for renaming, besides tidiness?

decisions.question: Fix 9 lint warnings in the tax scripts?
Publish the v2 migration guide to the docs site now?
decisions.reason: Customers will read it. I read it first.

decisions.question: The provider's annual plan saves $2,400 but is a 12-month contract. Take it?
decisions.reason: Not until the cutover has run clean for a month. What would we lose if they double-billed us mid-contract?

decisions.question: Bump typescript from 5.9.2 to 5.9.3 (patch)?
Add the zod library to the TypeScript SDK for response validation?
decisions.reason: No new runtime dependencies in the SDKs. Every one we add, every customer installs. I let date-fns in last month and I regret it.

decisions.question: A candidate's take-home is late. Extend the deadline by two days or close the loop?
decisions.reason: Anything about a person stays with me. Extend it, and tell them kindly.

decisions.question: Set up a 45-minute meeting with the docs team to align on the changelog wording?
decisions.reason: A one-page summary I can comment on beats a meeting.

decisions.question: Backfill corrected tax on 312 paid invoices from last quarter, or fix forward?
decisions.reason: What does a backfill do to customers who already paid? New emails, new amounts, confusion. Fix forward, note it, and show me the case for backfilling if there is one.

decisions.question: Delete 9 merged branches?
Push the docs typo fix straight to main? It's one character.
Grant the contractor read access to the billing database for the migration check?
decisions.reason: Access is mine, always. Who else has asked for this, and what's the narrowest thing that would work?

decisions.question: Two designs for the API key settings page. A: tabs. B: one scrolling page. Recommended: A.
decisions.typed: I can't pick from two sentences. Build both far enough to click and send me the links.

decisions.question: Fix formatting in the deploy scripts?
Drop the second invoice reviewer to ship the cutover two days early?
decisions.reason: Same answer as always in billing: I'd rather be late than wrong.

decisions.question: Accept the 7:30am Berlin sync invite (weekly)?
Retry policy: exponential backoff with jitter (recommended) or fixed 1s retries?
decisions.reason: Fine, but next time tell me what a customer sees during an outage under each, not the algorithm names.

decisions.question: Book the 6:05am flight to the Denver onsite ($212 cheaper than the 9:40)?
Announce the v2 beta on the company blog Thursday?
decisions.reason: I see every word customers see before it goes out. Send me the draft on a preview.

decisions.question: Bump vitest from 4.1.0 to 4.1.1 (patch)?
decisions.reason: You don't need me for this.
